transcript: 1: Agent: Hello, this is Marcus calling on a recorded line from Apex Financial regarding your overdue personal loan account.
2: Customer: Oh god, you people again. Stop calling me! I told you guys not to call me at work!
3: Agent: Ma'am, I understand your frustration, but we need to resolve the balance of $4,500. Can you make a payment today?
4: Customer: I'm currently bankrupt and I've hired a lawyer. Contact my attorney from now on or I will sue you!
5: Agent: I understand. Could you please provide your attorney's name and contact number so we can update the record?
6: Customer: His name is David Miller at 555-0198. Do not contact me directly ever again!
7: Agent: Thank you. I have noted attorney David Miller, 555-0198, on your file and will suspend direct outreach immediately. Have a good day.
1: Agent: Thanks for calling Meridian Mortgage Servicing. My name is Rachel. May I have your account number?
2: Customer: Yeah, account #88391. Look, I lost my job last week and I can't afford the $1,200 monthly payment. That's still too much right now. Could I do $700 now and $700 next month?
3: Agent: Let me note that — $700 today and $700 on the 15th of next month. I'll need a supervisor to approve the settlement split, I'll follow up by Friday.
4: Customer: Okay, perfect. Will my payment due date for this month be extended while we process this?
5: Agent: I can place a temporary 30-day hold on late fees starting today, but a permanent grace extension requires underwriting review.
6: Customer: Alright, sounds fair. I'll watch out for the follow-up.
1: Agent: Hello, this call may be monitored or recorded. Am I speaking with Arthur Pendelton regarding auto loan account #9042?
2: Customer: Who? No, you have the wrong number! Stop bothering me with these damn calls! Take me off your list!
4: Customer: It is, but I've had this number for two weeks. I don't know any Arthur. Don't contact me ever again!
5: Agent: My apologies. I will update our records immediately to remove this number.
